waiter.title: Call waiter
waiter.lead: Pick one or more. Your waiter gets it on their phone.

status.title: Order #{{number}}
status.eta: About {{minutes}} minutes. We'll show a banner when it's ready, even if you're on another screen.
status.readyHint: We bring it to your table
status.banner: Your food is ready! {{dish}} is on its way to table {{table}}.

ready.title: Your food is ready!
ready.body: {{dish}} is on its way to table {{table}}.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wifi.heading: Free Wi-Fi
wifi.lead: Copy the password, then pick the network in your phone's Wi-Fi settings.
wifi.qrLead: Show this to a friend. Their camera joins the network in one tap.
wifi.private: Guest network. {{name}} never sees what you browse.

pay.title: Pay & split bill
pay.tip: Add a tip for the team
pay.payWhole: Pay {{amount}} with MoMo. You approve it on your phone.
pay.waiting: Check your phone and enter your PIN to approve.
pay.paid: Paid. Your order is with the kitchen.
pay.failed: That didn't go through and nothing was taken. Try again?

loyalty.title: Loyalty card
loyalty.joinLead: Verify your phone number to keep your progress at {{name}}. No app to install.
loyalty.consent: Save my number so this restaurant can keep my stamps. I can delete it later.
loyalty.marketing: Send me offers by SMS or WhatsApp. I can turn this off later.
loyalty.scanAtTable: Show this QR code to your waiter at the table.
loyalty.claimLead: Your waiter enters this 6-character code to confirm your reward. Until staff confirm, nothing is taken from your card.
loyalty.earnStampVisitSub: Added automatically when you pay with Ozaa
loyalty.earnPointsSpendSub: Added automatically from your paid bill
loyalty.earnGame: Score {{score}}+ in Play while you wait
loyalty.expiryDays: Earned units stay active for {{days}} days.
loyalty.historyEmpty: Your paid visits and redemptions will appear here.
loyalty.progressOneStamp: 1 of {{total}}. One more and the next one is on us.
loyalty.progressMoreStamps: {{balance}} of {{total}}. {{left}} more and the next one is on us.
loyalty.privacyNote: Act 843: your phone number is kept only for this venue's card. Deleting your card erases your record here.

review.title: Leave a review
review.videoBody: 15 to 30 seconds. The restaurant can show it in their stories, only if you say yes.
review.consent: {{name}} can feature this video in their stories. Only your first name and rating are shown.
review.hint: Say what you ordered and what you loved

game.title: Play while you wait
game.name: Plate Stack
game.lead: Tap to drop the plate. Line it up with the one below. Whatever hangs over falls off.
game.offline: No ads. Works offline. Only a nickname you choose is saved.

simple.feedbackLead: This goes to the manager only and is never posted.

owner.madeUp: You made {{amount}} today, {{percent}}% more than last Saturday.
owner.madeDown: You made {{amount}} today, {{percent}}% less than last Saturday.
owner.alertPayout: The payout account is not checked yet.
owner.noBill: No open bill on this table.
owner.callOpen: Waiting for someone to pick this up.
owner.privateReply: This rating stays private. A reply goes only to the guest.
owner.canFeature: The guest allowed this video in stories.
owner.noFeature: The guest did not allow featuring.
owner.setupLead: Four steps, then the venue can take a first order.
owner.setupDone: You can print the table QR codes and open the floor.
owner.blocked: That screen is for another role.
owner.shellStock: Stock will watch ingredients and mark a dish sold out when a recipe runs out.
owner.stockNext1: Link each dish to the ingredients it uses.
owner.stockNext2: When a recipe hits zero, mark the dish sold out on the guest menu.
owner.stockNext3: Count stock after a paid order, not when the ticket is only received.
owner.shellPos: The register will take a counter order, cash, and a receipt.
owner.posNext1: Take an order at the counter without a table QR.
owner.posNext2: Take cash and print or share a receipt.
owner.posNext3: Send the same tickets the kitchen already sees from the floor.
owner.shellAi: The AI waiter will answer in English first. Twi, Ga and Ewe come after a native-speaker check.
owner.aiNext2: Add Twi, Ga and Ewe only after a native speaker checks the words.
owner.aiNext3: Take an order by text, then by voice.
owner.shellMarketing: Messages go only to members who ticked marketing. That box stays separate from the loyalty card.
owner.marketNext1: Send only to members who ticked marketing.
owner.marketNext2: Keep that consent separate from joining the loyalty card.
owner.marketNext3: WhatsApp and SMS wait until a provider is chosen.
owner.colourClose: This colour is very close to Ozaa orange. Guests may think the page belongs to Ozaa.
owner.emptyFloor: Add a table to see the floor.
owner.serviceOrder: This is the order guests see.
owner.loyaltyConfirmLead: Enter the 6-character code from the guest's card to confirm and deduct their reward.
owner.loyaltyModeLocked: Members already have earnings, so the earn mode stays.
owner.loyaltyCodeNotFound: That code is not active or has expired.

errors.offline: You're offline. Showing what we saved.
